correctness.rationale: Apply Parseval to F²: without collisions the fourth moment is 2S²−∑x_i², with exactly one extra cross term. Distinct pair collisions cannot share precisely one character because cancellation would identify characters. The only diagonal/diagonal, diagonal/off-diagonal, and off/off cases exhaust all pair incidences, even with 2-torsion. Their additional terms are respectively 2Re(a0² conj(a1²)), 4Re(a1² conj(a0a2)), and 8Re(a0a3 conj(a1a2)). Direct algebra yields a diagonal/diagonal bound 2S², one-midpoint identity −u²/2−v²+2uv=(u+v)²/7−(3u−4v)²/14 yielding 15/7, and four-variable AM−GM yielding 9/4. Equality forces support on collided characters and the exact listed phase and mass patterns. Independently verified the exact middle quadratic identity and valid realization examples in Z2×Z11, Z17, and Z7×Z7 (as supplied in inspectable verifier). These finite examples certify nonvacuity, not the universal proof.

originality.rationale: Best-of-knowledge original complete classification across arbitrary compact abelian duals, now including two distinct diagonal pairs (order-two torsion) with sharp K4^4=2. Earlier 12:56:39Z odd-order finite extension and 12:56:47Z torsion-free single-collision theorems already cover the other two numerical constants and their equality classes, but exclude diagonal/diagonal collision and do not quantify all compact abelian groups. The present result adds the missing 2-torsion incidence type and completes the universally quantified trichotomy. It is not entirely novel for the middle/parallelogram cases, and earlier coverage is explicitly recorded.
